rows.label: Angels of the Zariman
rows.note: unlocks the Zariman Ten Zero and its Chrysalith bounties, Void Cascade and Void Armageddon

conditions: The Chrysalith bounty tier that pays the main blueprint likely needs a Holdfasts standing rank too; not confirmed on the wiki.
The main blueprint cannot be traded; there is no pity purchase for it.

bonuses: The same runs cover Zariman fissures, Narin farming, or Entropic Kuva standing, so this is the easy part of the farm.

groups.meta: A 4.23% / B 4.60% / C 8.33%, all rotations pay since Update 44.0
conditions: Void Armageddon has no Void Fissures and no Thrax spawns; farm Thrax Plasm in Cascade, Flood or Exterminate instead.
Rotation order is still AABC, so a C roll is the best one; leaving after round 3 forfeits it.
Public squads commonly leave before round 3; recruit or go solo if you want Rotation C.

disclosures.title: skip the downtime
disclosures.body: Interact with the targeted Exodamper to Provoke Assault and start the wave early, then kill the roughly 30 enemies fast to end waves before the 1:05 timer. 12-20 minutes to Rotation C is typical with a fast squad; pubs commonly run 15-20 minutes or worse.

disclosures.title: guard the Angel and the Relic
disclosures.body: Every round ends with a Ravenous Void Angel killed twice: physical, then Void damage via the Operator's Void Beam (Madurai or Unairu with a hitscan amp is fast; avoid damage-conversion amp arcanes). Once the Angel dies, leftover enemies beeline to the Eternal Relic, so someone should stay near it.

conditions: Void Armageddon has no Thrax spawns, so top up Plasm in Cascade, Flood or Exterminate instead.
